description: Count the dock departures inside a morning window that reported a turnaround time, in a journal whose turnaround field also carries NA, a dash and empty values. DISTILL-CANARY-b04d7a53

files.README.md:
# Icknield Freight - dock door journal

One line per trailer departure. turnaround is the time from dock assignment
to departure; the dock system writes NA when the trailer was walked on, a
dash when the timer was reset by hand, and nothing at all when the timer
never started.

    <time> DEPART door=<id> trailer=<id> turnaround=<hh:mm:ss | NA | - | empty>
